question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence. 

As he got older, the two stoped going to the park, and their relationship began to deteriorate.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stoped"** is incorrectly spelt and does not exist in English. The correct spelling is "stopped". (रुका हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The car **stopped** suddenly at the red light.
 
 
 
• **"Stopped"** means to cease movement or operation. (रुकना)
 
 
• **Example: **He **stopped** the car to let the pedestrians cross the road.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deteriorate** (बिगड़ना): To become progressively worse.

 
 
• **Example: **His health began to deteriorate rapidly.
 
 
 
• **Older** (बूढ़ा): Having lived for a longer time; more aged.
 
 
• **Example: **My older brother is coming to visit us this weekend.
 
 
 
• **Relationship** (संबंध): The way in which two or more people or things are connected.
 
 
• **Example: **They have a very close relationship and share everything with each other.
